endpoint_condition: Public profile one-hot; no source condition
capacity_match: Each arm adds identical zero-initialized Linear(8,64) FiLM, 576 parameters. Unconditional and old-recipe inputs are constant norm-one vectors.
old_recipe: Original exact 50% F / 25% Fq / 25% historical Fb_TX + alpha*(F-Fb_TX). Same added module, initialization, source order and update/sample budget. Historical Fb_TX is only this control training input, never current RX.
pair_order: Shared PairedOrder over 1000x8 pairs; source=pair//8, endpoint=pair%8
evaluation: One final fixed-step calibration100 x8, baseline seed outputs reused; no intermediate selection, heldout, common500, or wireless frames

bootstrap.unit: calibration source paired; one bank shared across endpoints/arms/metrics
